# `probe_search.py`

Run the real parallel search on one route-4 segment from run 4's state, printing every attempt.
usage: python probe_search.py <segment> [scouts] [tries]

---

    python3 testing/probe_search.py          # any cwd; the bootstrap chdirs to the repo root

## What it touches

- **drives BizHawk** - replays, searches or steps frames
- writes `logs/`, `runs/`, `shots/`
